levels.title: Foundations
levels.blurb: The everyday toolkit. Know these cold before going deeper.

topics.title: Kotlin (master it)
topics.summary: 16 short daily lessons: types, null safety, functions, lambdas, classes, generics, collections, interop and what the compiler generates.

topics.title: Coroutines & Flow
topics.summary: 16 lessons: suspend under the hood, structured concurrency, cancellation, exceptions, Flow operators, StateFlow and testing.

topics.title: Compose
topics.summary: 16 lessons: phases, state, recomposition, stability, side effects, modifiers, layouts, lists, animation and performance.

topics.title: MVVM/MVI
topics.summary: 16 lessons: app layers, Clean Architecture, ViewModel, UI state, events, MVI reducers and a search feature built both ways.

topics.title: Room
topics.summary: 14 lessons: entities, DAOs, Flow queries, relations, transactions, migrations, offline-first and testing.

topics.title: Retrofit/Ktor
topics.summary: 15 lessons: HTTP basics, Retrofit and OkHttp, interceptors, token refresh, Ktor Client, errors and testing.
